About.title: Discipline, technique and the stage
About.p1: Dancesport joins two worlds: the precision of an athletic discipline and the expression of a stage art. A couple is judged on posture, timing, floorcraft and musicality — in a round that lasts barely ninety seconds.
About.p2: The federation builds the framework around that moment: the national calendar, adjudicator and coach education, club accreditation, athlete classification and the selection of the national squad.

Partners.title: Who we work with
Partners.body: The World DanceSport Federation sets the international competition rules, the age groups and the discipline definitions that national federations build on. Partner and sponsor logos appear here only with written authorisation from each organisation.
